note: Engine-level tests in the candidate harness (/tmp/cand). Gain = mean log-likelihood per race vs Engine v2.3 (res_C2_R) on the same races; A = 2024 validation (12,777 races), B = 2025-26 (23,729 races, re-used period). Point in time; no prices.

STD_state_standardised_margins.what: margins converted to seconds with each state's measured s/L (Qld 0.170, SA 0.1595, Vic 0.1619; NSW/WA/Tas/ACT left at the national figure, no assumption), then back to national lengths before the rating
STD_state_standardised_margins.verdict: slightly worse in both windows: do not introduce state margin corrections

C2S_plus_suit_kernel_distance_suitabilit.what: horse's own past surprises weighted by closeness of distance (Gaussian, 150 m), shrunk with 3 pseudo-runs, added as one third-layer term
C2S_plus_suit_kernel_distance_suitabilit.verdict: no gain: the engine's existing distance terms already carry it (the rating-level residual of +0.19 to +0.21 kg is absorbed)
